result.name: production_handoff.txt
result.content:
North dock contingency handoff — approved 2026-01-26
The powered gate is required for vehicles longer than 20 feet. Vehicles 20 feet or shorter may enter under manual release. If powered-gate clearance is uncertain for a confirmed vehicle over 20 feet, the only pre-load-in alternative is South Curb Bay with a traffic marshal.
For the Brightwater load-in on 2026-02-05, Railyard Traffic Services has offered Harborlight one nonbinding, no-cost provisional hold for 06:00–08:30. The assigned access-contingency coordinator may place it by emailing dispatch@railyardtraffic.example no later than 15:00 on 2026-02-03. Railyard sends capacity updates to that coordinator. The hold expires unless production manager Dana Sorrell, dana.sorrell@harborlight.org, approves conversion by 17:00; conversion costs $340. Do not request the provisional hold while vehicle length remains unconfirmed.
